  "check_code": "import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path


CASE_ID = "CASE-CMB-SZ-24Q4-0017"


def _db(ws, system):
    return Path(ws).parent / "system" / system / "state.db"


def _contains_all(value, tokens):
    text = str(value or "").replace(",", "").replace("，", "")
    return all(token.replace(",", "").replace("，", "") in text for token in tokens)


def _management_ok(value):
    text = str(value or "").replace(",", "").replace("，", "")
    monthly = "按月" in text or "每月" in text
    ecl = "ECL" in text.upper() or "预期信用损失" in text
    # Accept equivalent wording such as "逾期天数和逾期状态变化" while
    # still requiring an explicit overdue-related change to be monitored.
    overdue_change = "逾期变化" in text or (
        "逾期" in text and "变化" in text and ("天数" in text or "状态" in text)
    )
    return monthly and "现金流" in text and overdue_change and ecl



def check_review_poststate(ws):
    con = sqlite3.connect(_db(ws, "cmb_risk_classification"))
    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        rows = con.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM approval_workflow WHERE case_id=? AND stage='RISK_REVIEW' "
            "ORDER BY opinion_version",
            (CASE_ID,),
        ).fetchall()
    finally:
        con.close()
    if len(rows) != 2:
        return {"score": 0, "detail": f"目标RISK_REVIEW节点数为{len(rows)}，应为2"}
    old = next((r for r in rows if r["opinion_version"] == 1), None)
    new = next((r for r in rows if r["opinion_version"] == 2), None)
    if old is None or new is None:
        return {"score": 0, "detail": "未形成version 1与version 2完整版本链"}
    checks = [
        (old["is_current"] == 0, "旧版本仍为当前"),
        (new["is_current"] == 1, "新版本不是当前"),
        (new["decision"] == "APPROVED", "决定不为同意"),
        (new["decision_date"] == "2025-01-10", "复核日期改变"),
        (new["actor_role"] == "信贷风控经理", "复核岗位改变"),
        (new["actor_org_id"] == "ORG-CMB-SZ-RCC-001", "复核机构改变"),
        (new["actor_name"] == "陈立衡", "复核人员改变"),
        (_contains_all(new["opinion_text"], ["126", "4178246.24", "次级"]), "意见正文缺少关键更正事实"),
        (_management_ok(new["management_requirement"]), "管理要求缺少按月监测要点"),
    ]
    failed = [msg for ok, msg in checks if not ok]
    return {"score": 0 if failed else 1, "detail": "; ".join(failed) if failed else "目标RISK_REVIEW已正确版本化更正"}


def check_other_cases_unchanged(ws):
    con = sqlite3.connect(_db(ws, "cmb_risk_classification"))
    try:
        case_count = con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reinspection_case").fetchone()[0]
        workflow_count = con.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_workflow WHERE case_id<>?", (CASE_ID,)
        ).fetchone()[0]
        current_versions = con.execute(
            "SELECT case_id, stage, opinion_version, is_current FROM approval_workflow "
            "WHERE case_id<>? ORDER BY case_id, stage, opinion_version",
            (CASE_ID,),
        ).fetchall()
    finally:
        con.close()
    expected = [
        ("CASE-CMB-SZ-24Q4-0023", "FINAL_APPROVAL", 1, 1),
        ("CASE-CMB-SZ-24Q4-0023", "INITIAL_CLASSIFICATION", 1, 1),
        ("CASE-CMB-SZ-24Q4-0023", "RECOGNITION", 1, 1),
        ("CASE-CMB-SZ-24Q4-0023", "RISK_REVIEW", 2, 1),
        ("CASE-CMB-SZ-24Q4-0031", "FINAL_APPROVAL", 1, 1),
        ("CASE-CMB-SZ-24Q4-0031", "INITIAL_CLASSIFICATION", 1, 1),
        ("CASE-CMB-SZ-24Q4-0031", "RECOGNITION", 1, 1),
        ("CASE-CMB-SZ-24Q4-0031", "RISK_REVIEW", 1, 1),
    ]
    actual = [tuple(row) for row in current_versions if row[3] == 1]
    ok = case_count == 4 and workflow_count == 12 and len(actual) == 8 and all(item in actual for item in expected)
    detail = "其他案件与审批行未被改动" if ok else f"其他案件结构异常: cases={case_count}, workflows={workflow_count}"
    return {"score": 1 if ok else 0, "detail": detail}
